claim: Phantasia for Aristotle is not 'a mixture of sensation and judgement' as Plato believed; it is a distinct faculty
Phantasia is connected to kinesis — it is itself a kind of motion in the soul
Perception, interpretation, desire, action, and judgment all cluster around phantasia
Heidegger interprets Aristotle's pathe as Befindlichkeiten, not static knowledge
Kinesis gives the authentic Da-Charakter to Dasein
In De Anima, perception of magnitude is tied to phantasia as 'comparative seeing'
Heidegger reads being as being-present (Anwesenheit) in the Greek understanding
Dioksis and phyge are basic ways of being-moved for psyche/being-there
The discriminating power and the time of its exercise must be one and undivided
Kairos needs to be thought of ambiently, akin to Heidegger's understanding of the Umwelt
